_note: Machine-readable extract of the IWMAC Designer panel-generation rules. Hand-authored 2026-08-09 from the audit in DOCUMENTATION-AUDIT.md and the measurements in VENTILATION-GEOMETRY-CONTRACT.md. Prose documents remain authoritative; this file exists so a validator can check a generated panel without parsing Markdown. Every geometry value carries the evidence id it was measured from.

scope_tags.REF-9099: Measured from one production export of plant 9099 (or its committed masked twin). Reproduce it when cloning that panel; do not universalise it to another AHU without evidence.
scope_tags.SCREENSHOT: Derived from a rendered screenshot, not from JSON or source. Weaker than a measured export - it can be re-measured but has not been.
scope_tags.ADVISORY: Judgement, not a measured or code-derived fact. May be overridden with a stated reason.

E1.why_not_committed: Carries a live plant id and real driver ids; repo policy masks reference JSONs before commit.

E2.relation_to_E1: Same AHU, revised layout. Matched by role: 79 of 102 objects geometrically identical, 21 moved, 1 only in E1, 2 only in E2. Never diff these two by array index - the files order objects differently and an index diff reports 85/84/66 differences that are not real.

E3.notes: A different plant's 360.001. Adds z-index bands 20 and 300. Has NO bypass column at all, places the electric heater at (459,412) with tag LI401, puts the third sidebar header at y400, and duplicates sub_page_link_btn_* at identical coordinates. Proof that the bypass cluster and the y357 header are REF-9099, not VENT.

source_precedence.source: A panel JSON or screenshot supplied with the current task
A real production export of the same panel type

source_precedence.rule: Never average conflicting coordinates. Take the value from the highest-ranked source that has one.

envelope.note: Committed reference JSONs in this repo wrap the same document as {_note, envelope:{...}}. A live userscript export is flat. A reader must accept both: env = doc.get('envelope', doc).

obj_id_rule.spelling: verbatim - do not normalise capitalisation or 'correct' historic spelling
obj_id_rule.on_violation: An id with no palette entry renders as a broken undefined-class box.

encoding.evidence: Insert JSON reads files as UTF-8; production exports carry 13 (E1/E2) and 8 (E3) degree tags and zero 'gr C'; DESIGN-OBJECT-CATALOG.md itself prints RT401 °C.
encoding.note: The mojibake risk lives in other transports (terminal paste, the ISO-8859-1 page, old mail). Fix the transport; do not degrade the panel text.

unlinked_demo_contract.alias_text: PRESERVE - it is what a human links by afterwards
unlinked_demo_contract.prohibition: Never invent a driver id, unit id, parameter id, file path or panel target. An invented id looks linked and is not.

quality_metric.target: coverage of the production roles present in the reference

ventilation.identity: A process schematic drawn with palette objects, plus a right-hand control sidebar. Not a dashboard and not a table-style panel.

canvas.override: Match the plant if a supplied export says otherwise. 1400x755 and 1280x1024 also exist in the fleet.

background.image_data: the ~8 KB blank-sidebar PNG data URI, byte-identical across E1 and E2
background.rule: Objects-only means the ducts and equipment are Designer objects, NOT that the standard embedded background is removed. Never author an SVG process drawing behind a vent panel. Never bake live values, LEDs, alarms, fans, coils or dampers into a background.

composition.crossover: a vertical column joining the two runs
composition.sidebar: from x1150 to the canvas edge

z_indexes.mode: explicit bands OR the literal string "default" - never mixed in one panel
z_indexes.default_mode_note: Emitting "default" everywhere is legal, but then array order IS stacking order: ducts first, labels last.
z_indexes.importer_behaviour: The importer writes zIndex through verbatim; it substitutes "default" only when the field is missing.

connector_rule.con_down: value box sits ABOVE the run it reads
connector_rule.con_top: value box sits BELOW the run it reads
connector_rule.edge: the connector edge must land ON the duct; a stub that stops short is a defect

clusters.principle: Every major component is atomic. Move a cluster with ONE translation vector applied to every member. Never leave an alarm, an output or a temperature behind.
clusters.offset_convention: [dx, dy] from the component's own posLeft/posTop.

bypass.note: REF-9099 only. E3 has no bypass column at all - a unit with no recirculation leg omits the whole cluster.

intentional_overlaps.rule: The damper OVERLAYS a continuous duct column. NEVER shorten the vertical duct to make space for the damper.

heat_recovery.note: Frost-protection value where the unit has one. No duplicate decorative label - the rotor object carries its own tag.

cooler.warning: E1 and E2 swap RT4xx and RT5xx on the same coils. Copy POSITIONS from the reference and instrument CODES from the target plant.

electric_heater.note: E3 places its electric heater at (459,412) with tag LI401 - a different unit, not a correction.

sections.caption: Temperaturregulering
sections.note: E3 places this header at y400.

sidebar.header_size_note: 250x20 in every vent reference. The palette default for number_v3_header_grey75 is 60x25; AI-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS previously said 260x20 in one place and 250x20 in another. 250x20 is the measured value.

column_headings.why: number_v3_label_11px_norm renders LEFT-ALIGNED from posLeft. posWidth does not centre the text, so equal posWidth values do NOT imply visually centred text.
column_headings.formula: posLeft = C - W/2, where C is the column centre and W is the RENDERED text width

spacing.rule: A tag caption rendered above a value box collides with the value below it at this pitch. Prefer number_v3_60px_dark_no_conn_no_tag where the row label already names the signal; use number_v3_60px_dark_no_conn (with caption) only where no row label exists.

rules.rule: Fully inside the Aggregatstatus value pill, not covering the numeric value, retaining right and vertical padding.
Lower-left interior of the LV402 body. Not centred over the tag, not outside the body, not overlapping the output value below.

led_placement.containment_test: led.x0 >= body.x0 AND led.y0 >= body.y0 AND led.x1 <= body.x1 AND led.y1 <= body.y1

value_ownership.rule: No standalone label when the equipment object already renders its own tag.
No second caption when a value object renders tag_text.
Instrument code + unit goes in tag_text, and only on objects that render a tag.
Use a no-tag value object when a row label already names the value.

alignment.rule: Position left-aligned labels by rendered text width, not by box width.

overlap_rules.detection: Compare RENDERED extents, not posWidth. A left-aligned label whose text is narrower than its box does not overlap its neighbour even when the boxes intersect.
intentional: a value box sitting on the duct or pipe it belongs to
a con_* connector edge landing ON its duct
a damper symbol laid over a continuous duct column
an equipment body straddling the run it conditions
a status LED inside its own equipment body
overlap_rules.never: Never shorten a duct to clear a damper.

alarm_rules.placement: Beside the guarded component, never over its tag, value or control.

required_roles: bypass damper (where the unit has a recirculation leg)

qa.on_failure: Restart from the retained source export. Do not patch an already damaged derivative.
qa.tooltip_rule: Move the pointer off every panel object before capturing a QA screenshot. A Designer hover tooltip is runtime UI, not panel content.

evidence_required: Rendered text widths for every sidebar label object other than Tilluft and Avtrekk - the centring formula needs W per string per font.
Whether number_v3_label_12px_bold and the other label objects also render left-aligned, or only 11px_norm.
The Aggregatstatus pill's measured bounds, so LED containment can be checked numerically rather than by eye.
The frost-protection value's cluster offset from number_360_vg_rot - E1 has no frost value to measure.
The minimum vertical gap at which a tag caption stops colliding with the value box below it.
Whether the y357 vs y400 third-header position tracks section content height or is plant preference.
A production export of a vent panel WITH a bypass on a plant other than 9099, to promote the bypass geometry from REF-9099 to VENT.
